acceptance: Agent sessions authenticate as the separate identity (gh api user)
A stand-in posted by that identity is rejected by the gate
description: Agents run gh with the owner's token (scopes admin:org, gist, repo, workflow), and oracle_review_check STANDIN_ATTESTERS={'joeharris76'} checks only the login, so any agent can post a stand-in attestation. Create a GitHub App or fine-grained PAT for agents without admin or workflow scope and not in STANDIN_ATTESTERS; switch agent gh auth to it; keep stand-in attestation to a human-only identity.
